title: Bandung2024 reported post-handling road mean speed
referencePeriod: 2024 reporting year; Sesudah penanganan measurements; exact survey dates and hours not stated
updateFrequency: Annual accountability report; field-survey repetition not specified
missingness: All eight selected table rows have an observed Sesudah value. Broader road-network completeness and valid-day coverage are unknown.26 regions have no observations.
definition: Source-published Kecepatan Rata2, Sesudah column for each of eight selected road rows; no annual municipal average.
numerator: Not disclosed: distance component of the source mean-speed measurement.
denominator: Not disclosed: elapsed-time component and averaging weights of the source mean-speed measurement.
measurementMethod: Dinas Perhubungan measurements following handling on eight selected roads, published as before/after columns in Table2.49; preserve the Sesudah column exactly. The report states speed unit km/jam in the adjacent discussion. The field instrument, survey clock times and aggregation weights are undisclosed. No model, interpolation, averaging or effect calculation is performed by this audit.
licenseOrUsageNotes: Official publicly linked PPID report. No express restriction on narrow attributed factual transcription was found in inspected report/listing; no affirmative open license was located. PPID footer reserves rights. Store only researcher-authored receipts and selected numerical facts with author, title, access date, direct URL and table/row attribution. This is not permission to redistribute the original report in bulk or imply endorsement.

comparability.reason: Eight published road-site facts from one agency table only. Selection, survey dates and protocol prevent city-wide, cross-region or causal before/after comparisons; all automated comparisons and rankings disabled.

temporalWarning: Nearby-year context, not2023.2024 is the published reporting/processing year; exact dates and hours of Sesudah measurements are not specified. Do not call these full-year annual averages.
limitations: Only eight selected road sites in Kota Bandung; not the city road network or all trips. No municipal mean, rank or regional normalization is derived.
2024 is the report and source-processing year, not a complete calendar-year sampling window. Exact survey date, hour, duration, direction, sample size and measuring instrument are not reported.

The primary report says measurements followed road handling. It does not disclose a full reproducible measurement protocol; reproducible here means exact re-extraction of the published table, not independent repetition of field measurement.
Prose later labels all eight roads cleared, contrary to its earlier six-road account and two table rows. No clearance classification or causal-effect claim is released.
Narrative and Table2.49 give different Buah Batu segment limits. Retain table-specific site label and row locator; do not extend measurement to the whole road.
Public release date is unknown. Embedded PDF creation2025-03-24 and modification2025-05-02 are document metadata, not the observation period or release date.
Missing 26 CIVX regions are absent, not zero. Older-year before-treatment values are intentionally not imported because exact dates are unspecified.
knownBiases: Intervention-site selection overrepresents roads selected for treatment rather than a probability sample of municipal roads.
Unstated hours, days and directions can strongly affect traffic speed and V/C.
Traffic counts and vehicle-equivalent road capacity are not unique-person mobility or household access.
safeStatements: Dishub publishes a2024 post-handling value for this named road in Table2.49; exact survey dates are not disclosed.
This road-site observation is associated with Kota Bandung, not a municipal average.
unsafeStatements: This value represents all traffic in Kota Bandung in2023.
The eight roads represent all municipal roads or all residents.
This is a causal measured reduction in congestion caused by the intervention.
Use these values to rank all27 Jabar regions.
statementTemplates: Dalam laporan kinerja2024, Dinas Perhubungan Kota Bandung mencantumkan kecepatan rata-rata sesudah penanganan untuk {siteName} sebesar {value} km/jam. Tanggal dan jam survei tidak dirinci; angka ini bukan rata-rata kota.

sources.evidence: Read actual Table 2.49, printed page129 / PDF page136, plus adjacent methods on PDF pages136–137. Eight named road rows publish before/after V/C and mean-speed measurements after road handling. Store only the eight Sesudah column values for each metric; do not infer precise survey dates or annual averages. The text explicitly says measurements followed handling. Table and prose disagree: prose later calls all eight roads cleared, although the table and earlier narrative distinguish two uncleared roads. Buah Batu bounds also differ between narrative and table. Exclude classification and municipal aggregate claims. PDF release date is not stated; embedded creation 2025-03-24 and modification 2025-05-02 are not publication dates.
